item.title: Diesel prices soar as U.S. farmers preparing for harvest continue to feel squeezed
item.description: Diesel prices have spiked just in time for corn and soybean harvests. Farmers need the fuel to bring in the crops, and many were already hurting, but there are factors offsetting this latest setback.
item.content:encoded: Diesel prices have spiked just in time for corn and soybean harvests. Farmers need the fuel to bring in the crops, and many were already hurting, but there are factors offsetting this latest setback.
item.dc:creator: Frank Morris

item.title: The first day of school: Bells, bikes, buses and big feelings
item.description: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

item.title: Labor unions nationwide are navigating the explosive growth of AI
item.description: Unions are trying to figure out where they stand on AI. While some are focused on greater protections for workers, the building trades unions are already reaping benefits from the data center boom.
